2014_spells.tiny-servant.description: You touch one Tiny object that isn't a weapon or worn or held, and the object animates. The object sprouts little arms and legs and becomes a Tiny servant.
2014_spells.tiny-servant.effectSummary: Change a target: touch one Tiny object that isn't a weapon or worn or held, and the object animates
2014_spells.tiny-servant.fullDescription: Using 1 minute, you touch one Tiny object that isn't a weapon or worn or held, and the object animates. The object sprouts little arms and legs and becomes a Tiny servant; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can touch and animate one additional Tiny object for each slot level above 3rd. The effect lasts for 8 hours.
